{"analysis": "Comparing candidate platforms against the selection criteria for a 2026 enterprise LLM Agent platform reveals distinct architectural roles rather than direct substitutes. DeepAgents [source_001] is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph, supplying planning, sub-agents, a filesystem abstraction, and human-in-the-loop controls; it is well matched to the fixed-DAG execution criterion and benefits from LangGraph's [source_002] durable state and explicit node/edge model. The tradeoff is that DeepAgents adds orchestration complexity and LangChain coupling, and its value diminishes if autonomous planning is enabled, since the v0.1 router assumes a pre-decomposed DAG [source_006]. LangGraph alone [source_002] satisfies execution and statefulness with less overhead but lacks the higher-level harness affordances (sub-agents, filesystem, HITL) that DeepAgents packages. Pydantic AI [source_003] addresses only structured-output correctness; it is orthogonal to routing and should be adopted only if schema validation becomes a measured bottleneck, avoiding premature dependency weight. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) [source_004] is explicitly reserved for the outer validation environment, not the core routing loop, so it is a benchmarking/instrumentation counterpart rather than a runtime competitor. Against the routing-specific criteria, none of these platforms alone delivers per-node model selection; that capability is the open gap [source_005] the platform must close by treating a fixed DAG as router input [source_006] and benchmarking quality, cost, and critical-path latency [source_007] with a versioned scoring rubric [source_008]. {"title":"2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型报告","sections":[{"heading":"Executive Summary","paragraph":"本报告评估 DeepAgents、LangGraph、Pydantic AI 与 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 在 2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台中的角色。DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph [source_001]，适合固定 DAG 执行；DSH 仅用于外部验证环境 [source_004]；基准需报告质量、成本与关键路径延迟 [source_007]。核心缺口为按节点路由，需在固定 DAG 上构建并测量 [source_005][source_006]。"},{"heading":"Background","paragraph":"企业 LLM Agent 平台需在质量、成本与延迟间权衡。现有路由研究多为整请求选模型 [source_005]。本平台采用静态任务分解，路由器接收 DAG 作为输入，聚焦按节点选型 [source_006]。DeepAgents 提供规划、子代理、文件系统抽象与人机协同 [source_001]，LangGraph 提供显式节点/边与持久状态 [source_002]。"},{"heading":"Selection Criteria","paragraph":"选型标准包括：固定 DAG 执行能力、状态持久化、人机协同、结构化输出支持、以及按节点路由能力。DeepAgents 满足执行与 HITL [source_001]；LangGraph 满足状态与图模型 [source_002]；Pydantic AI 仅在结构化输出成为瓶颈时采用 [source_003]；DSH 限于验证环境 [source_004]。按节点路由为开放缺口 [source_005]。"},{"heading":"Platform Comparison","paragraph":"DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph [source_001]，提供高层编排但增加复杂度；LangGraph 更轻量但缺子代理等能力 [source_002]；Pydantic AI 仅解决 schema 验证 [source_003]；DSH 为验证环境插件 [source_004]。无平台原生支持按节点选型 [source_005]，需在固定 DAG 上自建路由 [source_006]，并以质量、成本、关键路径延迟为基准 [source_007]。"},{"heading":"Risks","paragraph":"主要风险：DeepAgents 的 LangChain 耦合与编排复杂度 [source_001]；启用自主规划会削弱固定 DAG 假设 [source_001]；Pydantic AI 过早引入依赖 [source_003]；DSH 误用于核心循环 [source_004]；按节点路由未验证前动态重拆分不可行 [source_006]。基准需保持可复现，评分规则版本化 [source_008]。"},{"heading":"Conclusion","paragraph":"推荐 DeepAgents+LangGraph 作为执行与 HITL 基础 [source_001][source_002]，Pydantic AI 条件采用 [source_003]，DSH 限于验证 [source_004]。按节点路由为差异化能力，需在固定 DAG 上构建并测量质量、成本与关键路径延迟 [source_005][source_006][source_007]，评分规则版本化 [source_008]。"},{"heading":"References","paragraph":"[source_001] DeepAgents: LangChain harness on LangGraph [ed7d5a479cc077720b641eb8ecf4a25c3af32701fc8403138c57532c6dd03d39];
